Name: CP - Backwoods Entry for Zenith Farm
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
I found it irritating that when you are leaving Zenith farm from the top right to go to the backwoods, you are still facing right when you need to go up. This changes the entrance to the backwoods so that you continue going right.

This is my first mod ever and it is very simple, so if there's something wrong please let me know and I will try to fix it! It has worked when I tested it on my save though.

Directions:
1. Download file
2. Extract this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder
3. That should be it!!!!

Because highly requested, this should now be compatible with both SVE and RSV :) (thanks to Jayjaydub for help with this!)

Downloads.Description: Fixed manifest, and hopefully any problems people have with the spawning should be fixed now. Lmk in the posts if it still doesn't work

Manifest.Name: Backwoods Entry for Zenith Farm
Manifest.Description: Changes the backwoods entry from Zenith farm so that you are leaving the farm and entering the backwoods in the same direction.
